svg.aria-label: Without truffle, two devices talk through a relay server you run. With truffle, they talk directly over WireGuard.
svg.title: Without truffle, two devices talk through a relay server you run. With truffle, they talk directly over WireGuard.
svg.desc: Left: alice-laptop and bob-phone joined through a relay server. Right: the same two devices joined by one direct, encrypted line, with no server of your own, identity and access rules from your tailnet, and nothing on the public internet.
